normalization: Unicode NFC → lowercase → ё to е → Unicode punctuation (category P*) replaced by spaces → whitespace collapsed. Words, numbers, negations and self-corrections are retained. CER includes spaces in normalized strings. Empty normalized references are kept: hypothesis tokens count as insertions; a rate with zero reference denominator is null (undefined), even for two empty strings. Their errors still contribute to corpus totals. Corpus rates are summed errors / summed reference units, never mean per-record rates.
